{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
df_clean = df[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].dropna()

# Reset the index to ensure it is a clean integer range
df_clean = df_clean.reset_index(drop=True)

# Compute Pearson correlation
correlation = df_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(df_clean['body_mass_g'])

# Print only the correlation value and the number of rows used
print(f'Number of rows used: {len(df_clean)}')
print(f'Pearson correlation coefficient: {correlation}')"}
